2. **`scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs` `NOT_DRIVER_MANAGED`, the `docs/audits/**` entry (L854):** calls the strictness `.counts.md` "The ONE exception" among hand-written audit ledgers, but `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md` is also generated whole (its first lines: "GENERATED — DO NOT EDIT BY HAND", "Regenerate: node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write") and is not routed either.

## Wanted

Make both comments say what the code does now. For item 2, say whether the tenant-audit `.counts.md` should be routed like the strictness one (it is generated whole, so the prose-loss argument does not apply) or record why not. Comments only unless that routing is chosen, which then needs the regen gate in the PR.
